goal: Translate catalogue browsing into an original industrial bento mosaic where one cell docks an inspector, instead of a three-rail gallery or a paper index-stage.
core_concept: A dark industrial plate of unequal bento cells. Selecting a cell docks a side inspector with the cell's reading; neighboring cells stay put. Browsing is docking, not restaging a single hero or lifting a card.

sections: plate header with yard name and live cell count
unequal bento mosaic of original signal plates
docked inspector that appears from the selected cell
composition_plan.spatial_system: Desktop is a 12-column mosaic with 8/4 and 4/4/4 spans; the dock is a 4-column inspector that occupies the right of the selected row. No persistent left nav rail. Mobile stacks cells full-width.
composition_plan.visual_hierarchy: The mosaic is primary; dock copy is secondary; yard notes are quiet.
composition_plan.pacing: Dense mosaic first, then a longer notes band, then a short return.
composition_plan.density: High in the mosaic, low in the notes band.

typography_plan.display_role: Condensed uppercase system sans with wide tracking for the plate header.
typography_plan.body_role: Regular system sans for dock copy and notes.
typography_plan.scale_strategy: Oversized header, compact cell labels, readable dock body.
typography_plan.contrast_strategy: Acid lime on graphite instead of violet gradients or rust paper.
typography_plan.rhythm: Tight cell labels, wide header tracking, generous notes measure.
typography_plan.responsive_behavior: Header wraps; mosaic becomes a single column; dock stacks under the selected cell.

art_direction.imagery_strategy: CSS plates, hatch fills, and lime rules. No source media.
art_direction.asset_strategy: Inline HTML/CSS/JS only; no external assets.
art_direction.material: Industrial plate, lime signal, charcoal wells.
art_direction.depth: Unequal cell spans and a docked inspector plane, not card lift or paper reticle.
art_direction.color_logic: Graphite field, lime signal, pale dock text.

signature_move.name: cell dock
signature_move.central_idea: The first mosaic cell opens a docked inspector beside it so the selected plate keeps its place while its reading becomes available.
signature_move.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on the first mosaic cell
signature_move.visual_transformation: The dock panel opacity and translateX move from hidden/reveal-x to visible while the cell outline becomes lime.
signature_move.purpose: Keep the mosaic stable while exposing the selected cell's reading.
signature_move.content_relationship: The dock text belongs only to the first cell.
signature_move.reduced_motion_alternative: Show the dock and lime outline in final position with no translation.
signature_move.capture_checkpoint: desktop hover on the first mosaic cell after a 1250ms stable checkpoint

scroll_storyboard: initial: header and first mosaic row
mid-scroll: lower mosaic row and notes
signature: first cell docks its inspector
transitions: use duration-slow and easing-out-expo for the dock
use duration-med and easing-snap for cell outline
disable transitions and transforms under prefers-reduced-motion
motion_plan.reduced_motion_behavior: Remove transitions and transforms; keep dock, outline, hierarchy, and focus at rest.

retained_principles: one focused interaction explains a preview
luminous accent is localized to the active object
prohibited_copying: React Bits source, branding, copy, fonts, media, or components
V0 Signal Shelf and V1 Index Stage geometry

design_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited React Bits reference only for abstract catalogue-browse principles while composing an original industrial mosaic that is not a gallery clone.
knowledge_used: dark application shell separates a left navigation rail, central gallery, and right support rail
repeated rounded preview panels with compact metadata make a large catalogue browseable
violet, magenta, and electric-blue gradients are concentrated in previews and primary actions
search, category filtering, theme/preferences, and card focus states are explicit browse affordances
preview motion is observed as an interaction intent only; exact timing and implementation remain unclaimed

composition_differences: Replace rails and inspector with an unequal bento mosaic and a docked reading.
Use 12-column industrial spans instead of a card shelf or two-column paper stage.
Put notes after the mosaic rather than in a persistent right rail.
typography_differences: Use condensed uppercase tracking for the plate header.
Use lime on graphite instead of paper rust or violet dark UI.
motion_differences: Signature docks an inspector beside a stable cell rather than lifting a card or drawing a reticle.
Dock uses opacity and translateX tokens, not scale-on-preview.
originality_plan.asset_non_reuse: All visuals are original CSS plates; no source, V0, or V1 motifs are reused.
originality_plan.signature_move_hypothesis: A docked inspector should prove browsing can keep the mosaic in place while exposing one cell's reading.

quality_hypothesis: An industrial mosaic with a docked inspector should be a second original direction, distinct from V0 and V1. Human review must decide taste; no winner is inferred.
